free_tier.stated: $5 to $20 prepaid credit packs to start, up to 100 concurrent sandboxes, on the same Firecracker microVMs as the paid tiers

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Network egress is free: the pricing page states no allowance cap and no per-GB price
egress.free_allowance: no cap stated; egress is free

interface_detail: HTTP API, the `tl` CLI, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and standard SSH, scp, sftp and rsync into a sandbox

limits.value: up to 100 concurrent sandboxes; prepaid credit packs start at $5

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not documented. email is the assumed default because priced hosts require an account; sign-up requirements are unconfirmed for this provider.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22. The credit is prepaid rather than granted, which is a different product from a free tier and the record says so
